# ankra_pipeline_repository (Resource)

A Git repository connected to Ankra Pipelines, so pushes, pull requests and tags run its committed `.ankra/pipeline.yaml`; it needs no application. The counterpart of `ankra pipeline repositories connect` and `disconnect`, with `set-cluster` and `set-mode` changing it in place.

**Destroy waits for live runs.** The platform refuses to disconnect a repository while a pipeline run is queued or running; destroy retries until the run settles, for up to the `delete` timeout (10 minutes by default).

**Linked applications.** Deleting the application `application_id` names unlinks the repository on the platform, which then reads back with no application and plans a replacement. Remove `application_id` from the configuration (or destroy this resource) together with the application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A repository with no application, such as a library or a values repository.
resource "ankra_pipeline_repository" "platform" {
  provider_name   = "github"
  owner           = "acme"
  name            = "platform"
  credential_name = "github-main"
  default_branch  = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository name. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `owner` (String) Repository owner or organisation. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `provider_name` (String) Source-code provider: `github`, `gitlab` or `bitbucket_cloud`. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application to link the repository to. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster the repository's runs go to, overriding the organisation's CI cluster. Changes in place; unset uses the organisation's.
- `credential_name` (String) Organisation credential the repository is reached through. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `default_branch` (String) Branch the pipeline file is read from. Defaults to `main`. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `workspaces_only` (Boolean) Connect the repository for AI workspaces only: Ankra records no pipeline and starts no runs for it. Defaults to `false`. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the connected repository.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by repository id.
terraform import ankra_pipeline_repository.platform 3c7e1b2a-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
```
